Package com.sicomsa.dmt.svc

Class SolicitaService

java.lang.Object
com.sicomsa.dmt.svc.AbstractSvc<P,Q>
com.sicomsa.dmt.svc.AbstractGenericSvc<SolicitaResponse,Query>
com.sicomsa.dmt.svc.SolicitaSvc
com.sicomsa.dmt.svc.SolicitaService
All Implemented Interfaces:
Service<SolicitaResponse,Query>
public class SolicitaService extends SolicitaSvc
Concrete implementation that consumes SAT's download web service for requesting downloads:
"https://cfdidescargamasivasolicitud.clouda.sat.gob.mx/SolicitaDescargaService.svc"

As of SAT's certificate download web service new version (1.5) 2025-05-30, download requests are now split in these three types: download request for emitted certificates; received certificates; and downlad request by id (folio). This class extends SolicitaSvc to adapt the service to allow diferent types of requests and responses when requesting a download. It uses a RequestContext that provides the specific information of the request to be made to the service.

This class has concrete methods to add content of the download request (Query) to the SOAPMessage to send, sign the message, and parse the response from SAT in a SolicitaResponse instance which will contain the relevant data of the response.

If SolicitaResponse's method isAccept(), returns true will mean the request was accepted and we can now verify using SolicitaResponse's method getRequestId() which will give us the request id that should be used to verify the request.
